Lady should neither care to make Friends to his Majesty

source_continuation
Majesty ... or any else for delivery
The sentence about seeking assistance continues across the physical PDF505–506 seam.
One continuous reported recommendation, not two independent interventions.

source_groups.label: Disjunctive past-versus-future release forecast and purported solar commander
claims: source_internal_judgement
either was or would
Lilly explicitly offers both past and future status as alternatives.
The already-released branch prevents this from being a clean forward prediction.
source_internal_forecast
within three dayes be discharged
In the future branch he forecasts release within three days.
Conditional on not already released; cannot score without verified status at question time.
source_internal_forecast
by meanes of a Solare man Commander
He attributes the release to a Sun-associated commander.
Historically chart-derived actor identity, not independently confirmed.
source_internal_forecast
who would release him
The commander is expected to free the imprisoned husband.
Distinct from a specific release date.
source_internal_forecast
furnish him with what convenient necessity
He predicts material support and supplies for the freed person.
A separate practical endpoint from release.

Distinct military outcome from personal release.
authorial_outcome_claim

authorial_outcome_claim
